newsitem.title: USA: Texaco picks BBDO for global ad account.
newsitem.headline: Texaco picks BBDO for global ad account.

text.p: Texaco Inc said it named Omnicom Group Inc's BBDO Worldwide unit as lead advertising agency on its corporate account.
The selection follows a five-month review process, Texaco said.
The company did not elaborate on the size of the account.
Texaco and BBDO officials were not immediately available for comment.
Texaco spokesman Chris Gidez said that Bates USA will continue working on Texaco's product advertisements.
Texaco in August opened a review of its corporate account. That followed the company's July 1 promotion of Peter Bijur to chairman and chief executive.
BBDO Worldwide, D'Arcy Masius Benton & Bowles, Messner Vetere Berger McNamee Schmetterer/Euro RSCG, and Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising, all in New York, were in the review, Texaco said.
The corporate account is separate from the product account, Gidez said.
Industry sources estimated Texaco's corporate advertising account to be about $12 million.
Gidez said that was not an accurate figure.
He said the company still has not yet determined the size of the account.
